messages.author: dc06d729e023580a
messages.subject: Error bars
parts:
Hi all,

Could you please recommend any good resources you know of on error
bars. I'm particularly interested in papers that discuss the
difference between the standard error of the means and standard error
of the difference of means, particularly for models where this might
be very different (e.g. mixed models)

Thanks!

Hadley

--
Assistant Professor / Dobelman Family Junior Chair
Department of Statistics / Rice University
http://had.co.nz/

messages.author: affa918ed63b6275
messages.subject: Re: Error bars
parts:
Hi,

How about these refs:

Cumming, G., & Finch, S. (2003). Inference by Eye: Confidence
intervals and how to read pictures of data. American Psychologist,
60(2), 170-180.

Belia, S., Fidler, F., Williams, J., & Cumming, G. (2005). Researchers
misunderstand confidence intervals and standard error bars.
Psychological Methods, 10(4), 389-396.

the difference of mean may be somewhat relevant to the within-subject design.

kohske

--
Kohske Takahashi <takahash...@gmail.com>

Research Center for Advanced Science and Technology,
The University of  Tokyo, Japan.
http://www.fennel.rcast.u-tokyo.ac.jp/profilee_ktakahashi.html
